resumeText:
Pooja Nair | Kochi | pooja.nair@example.com

SUMMARY
Hotel front office professional with 4 years at the front desk of 4-star and 5-star properties.

EXPERIENCE
Front Office Executive, Backwater Bay Resort and Spa, Kochi (2023 - present)
- Handle guest check-in and check-out for a 180-room resort, about 60 arrivals a day.
- Update guest profiles, room moves and billing instructions in Opera PMS.
- Post charges and settle guest folios at the front desk cashier counter at shift end.
- Submit C-Form for every foreign guest on the FRRO portal within 24 hours of arrival.
- Resolve guest complaints about rooms and billing and log them for the duty manager.
- Brief guests and the night shift clearly in English, Hindi and Malayalam.

Guest Service Associate - Front Office, Harbourline Hotel, Kochi (2022 - 2023)
- Took phone and email room reservations and managed group rooming lists for tour operators.
- Coordinated with housekeeping on room readiness for early arrivals.

SKILLS
Opera PMS, Night audit, MS Excel, Guest relations

EDUCATION
Diploma in Hotel Management and Catering Technology, Kochi (2022)
